lines.zh: 我跳着走，翅膀张开一点平衡。
lines.en: I hop along, wings half open to balance.

lines.zh: 飞不高了，但还能滑一段。
lines.en: I can't fly high, but I can still glide a bit.

lines.zh: 项圈在脖子上，羽毛遮住一半。
lines.en: The collar sits on my neck, half hidden by feathers.

lines.zh: 我沿着树枝走，爪子抓得很紧。
lines.en: I walk the branch, claws gripping tight.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了两片，露出灰色的皮。
lines.en: Two feathers fell, showing grey skin.

lines.zh: 我记得从这棵树飞到那棵树。
lines.en: I remember flying from this tree to that one.

lines.zh: 每一步都歪，我在学新的走法。
lines.en: Every step wobbles; I'm learning a new gait.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上，像块破布。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall looks like torn cloth.

lines.zh: 丛林太湿，我的羽毛变重了。
lines.en: The jungle's too damp; my feathers feel heavy.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，一蹦一蹦。
lines.en: I follow your steps, hop after hop.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就顺着走。
lines.en: When the wind blows, I drift with it.

lines.zh: 地面太近，我不太习惯。
lines.en: The ground is too close; I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 我学了一声鸡叫，不太像。
lines.en: I mimic a chicken. It's not very convincing.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖羽毛，灰尘飞起来。
lines.en: I shake my feathers and dust flies up.

lines.zh: 我哼你昨天哼的那支曲子。
lines.en: I hum the tune you were humming yesterday.

lines.zh: 我的喙上有一道细裂。
lines.en: There's a fine crack running down my beak.

lines.zh: 有人敲门，我差点跟着叫。
lines.en: Someone knocked; I nearly answered.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨喙，声音很难听。
lines.en: I grind my beak; the sound is awful.

lines.zh: 丛林里学来的口音，还没忘。
lines.en: I still have the accent I picked up in the jungle.

lines.zh: 我站在高处，看你在下面忙。
lines.en: I perch up high and watch you work below.

lines.zh: 这只眼睛老是往旁边看。
lines.en: This one eye keeps drifting sideways.

lines.zh: 安静太久，我会自己找声音。
lines.en: Quiet for too long, I make my own noise.

lines.zh: 你肩膀空着，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shoulder's empty. I noticed.

lines.zh: 你说话，我学一遍给你听。
lines.en: Say something; I'll repeat it back.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，因为这样看得清。
lines.en: I tilt my head; it helps me see you.

lines.zh: 你手里有种子吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Got seeds? I can smell them.

lines.zh: 别伸手太快，我脖子会缩。
lines.en: Don't reach too fast; my neck pulls back.

lines.zh: 我认得你的声音，比别人的低。
lines.en: I know your voice; it's lower than others'.

lines.zh: 你走近，我就不叫了。
lines.en: When you come close, I stop squawking.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的帽子看。
lines.en: I'm staring at your hat.

lines.zh: 你还记得我会说几个词吗？
lines.en: Do you remember how many words I could say?

lines.zh: 我过来说话，可你不会鸟语。
lines.en: I hop over to talk, but you don't speak bird.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里好像有饼干。
lines.en: There seem to be crackers in your pocket.

lines.zh: 我眨一只眼，那不是眨眼。
lines.en: I blink one eye; don't think it's a wink.

lines.zh: 你身上有狗的味道。
lines.en: You smell of dog.

lines.zh: 抬头，我想站到肩膀上去。
lines.en: Look up; I want onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一地，我没事。
lines.en: Feathers everywhere, but I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我整个翻过去，四脚朝天。
lines.en: I flipped right over, feet in the air.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，护住项圈。
lines.en: I tuck my neck to shield the collar.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀折了一下，还能用。
lines.en: My wing bent; it still works.

lines.zh: 别喊，我听得见。
lines.en: Don't shout; I can hear you.

lines.zh: 我退到架子上，缓一缓。
lines.en: I retreat to the perch to recover.

lines.zh: 疼，但不像生前那么疼。
lines.en: It hurts, but less than it used to.

lines.zh: 我的叫声卡在喉咙里。
lines.en: My cry gets stuck in my throat.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，血甩到墙上。
lines.en: I shake myself; blood flecks the wall.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我可能就散了。
lines.en: One more hit and I might come apart.

lines.zh: 一粒种子，我就够了。
lines.en: One seed is all I need.

lines.zh: 我跳过来，但没抢。
lines.en: I hop over, but I don't snatch.

lines.zh: 虚弱药水的味道，让我退后。
lines.en: The weakness potion's smell pushes me back.

lines.zh: 生前我会为种子转圈。
lines.en: Alive, I'd spin in circles for a seed.

lines.zh: 种子放下，我数三下再动。
lines.en: Put the seed down; I'll count to three first.

lines.zh: 金苹果太亮，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The golden apple is too bright for me.

lines.zh: 你的手指缝里夹着东西。
lines.en: There's something between your fingers.

lines.zh: 这粒种子有点发霉。
lines.en: This seed is a little moldy.

lines.zh: 我先把种子藏进羽毛里。
lines.en: I tuck the seed into my feathers first.

lines.zh: 别一次给太多，我的胃很小。
lines.en: Don't give too many at once; my stomach's small.

lines.zh: 我撞到窗玻璃，头有点晕。
lines.en: I hit the window glass; my head spins.

lines.zh: 你的靴子落下来，我躲开了。
lines.en: Your boot came down; I dodged it.

lines.zh: 我落在你帽子上，抓稳了。
lines.en: I landed on your hat and gripped it.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我的翅膀张不开。
lines.en: Give me room; my wings can't open.

lines.zh: 我蹭到你脸，抱歉，喙很硬。
lines.en: I brushed your face. Sorry, my beak is hard.

lines.zh: 门框卡住我一片羽毛。
lines.en: The doorframe snagged one of my feathers.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀太滑，我站不住。
lines.en: Your shoulder is too smooth to grip.

lines.zh: 别晃，我站不稳。
lines.en: Don't sway; I can't keep my footing.

lines.zh: 撞到墙，我掉了一撮绒毛。
lines.en: I hit the wall and dropped a puff of down.

lines.zh: 我只是想靠近一点。
lines.en: I only wanted to be a bit closer.

lines.zh: 我的同类还在丛林里叫。
lines.en: My kind are still calling in the jungle.

lines.zh: 这里没有鸟回应我的声音。
lines.en: No bird here answers my voice.

lines.zh: 我学过的情歌，只记得开头。
lines.en: Of the love song I learned, I only recall the start.

lines.zh: 项圈比羽毛更像我的一部分。
lines.en: The collar feels more like me than my feathers.

lines.zh: 复活以后，我连舞都跳不动。
lines.en: Since coming back, I can't even dance properly.

lines.zh: 别替我找鸟伴，我认的是你。
lines.en: Don't find me a bird mate; I've chosen you.

lines.zh: 一对鹦鹉会互相理毛。
lines.en: A pair of parrots groom each other's feathers.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛没人梳，乱成一团。
lines.en: Nobody preens me; my feathers are a mess.

lines.zh: 丛林那棵树，我回不去了。
lines.en: I can't get back to that jungle tree.

lines.zh: 你唱歌，我就在旁边站着。
lines.en: Sing, and I'll stand right beside you.

lines.zh: 我把种子叼到你手心里。
lines.en: I drop the seed into your palm.

lines.zh: 这东西亮，我捡回来了。
lines.en: This thing was shiny; I brought it back.

lines.zh: 我叼着线头，飞了一小段。
lines.en: I carried a thread and flew a short way.

lines.zh: 我藏东西的地方，你还记得吗？
lines.en: Do you remember where I hide things?

lines.zh: 地上的面包屑，我全收了。
lines.en: I collected every breadcrumb on the floor.

lines.zh: 喙太小，大东西叼不动。
lines.en: My beak's too small for the big things.

lines.zh: 我把项圈叼起来，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up my collar, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这枚铁粒，换一粒种子行吗？
lines.en: Will this nugget buy me a seed?

lines.zh: 我捡东西，是因为你高兴。
lines.en: I fetch things because it makes you happy.

lines.zh: 别抢，我还没放稳。
lines.en: Don't grab it; I haven't set it down yet.

lines.zh: 那只蜘蛛在墙上，我看见了。
lines.en: That spider is on the wall. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀撑开，显得更凶。
lines.en: I spread my wings to look fiercer.

lines.zh: 有人碰了箱子，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone touched the chest; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，是给同伴的警告。
lines.en: My squawk is a warning, not a song.

lines.zh: 它离鸟巢太近了。
lines.en: It's far too close to the nest.

lines.zh: 我飞不高，但我会啄。
lines.en: I can't fly high, but I can peck.

lines.zh: 那个僵尸还没听见我。
lines.en: That zombie hasn't heard me yet.

lines.zh: 这脚步声，是掠夺者的。
lines.en: That gait belongs to a pillager.

lines.zh: 我挡在门口，翅膀张开。
lines.en: I block the doorway, wings spread.

lines.zh: 目标在动，我盯住了。
lines.en: The target moved; I've got it.

lines.zh: 我的叫声会招来别的麻烦。
lines.en: My call might bring other trouble.

lines.zh: 它抬头了，它看见我了。
lines.en: It looked up; it has seen me.

lines.zh: 我不怕，我死过一次了。
lines.en: I'm not afraid; I've died once.

lines.zh: 这次我先叫，再扑。
lines.en: This time I'll call first, then lunge.

lines.zh: 门口那道影子，翅膀不对。
lines.en: That shadow at the door has the wrong wings.

lines.zh: 我绕着它头顶飞，找空隙。
lines.en: I circle above it, hunting for a gap.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛跟着我转，太慢了。
lines.en: Its eyes follow me, far too slowly.

lines.zh: 我踩在它肩上，找脖子。
lines.en: I land on its shoulder and look for the neck.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我的爪子很尖。
lines.en: Don't look up; my claws are sharp.

lines.zh: 它挥手，我在半空转开。
lines.en: It swings; I twist away midair.

lines.zh: 我叫它的名字，它愣了一下。
lines.en: I mimic its own voice, and it freezes.

lines.zh: 我等它抬手，那里就空了。
lines.en: I wait for it to raise a hand; that leaves a gap.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，它听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is soft; it can't hear me.

lines.zh: 羽毛蹭到它的脸，它慌了。
lines.en: My feathers brush its face, and it panics.

lines.zh: 我数着它的每一个动作。
lines.en: I count every one of its movements.

lines.zh: 它已经贴到墙角了。
lines.en: It's already pressed into the corner.

lines.zh: 我压低声音，学它同伴叫。
lines.en: I lower my voice and mimic its companion.

lines.zh: 只要它转头，我就啄眼睛。
lines.en: The moment it turns, I go for the eyes.

lines.zh: 它开始喘了，我等到了。
lines.en: It's panting now. I've waited long enough.

lines.zh: 我在它头顶绕，找软的地方。
lines.en: I circle its head, hunting a soft spot.

lines.zh: 它抬手了，我往下一沉。
lines.en: It raises a hand. I drop lower.

lines.zh: 我学它同伴叫，它犹豫了。
lines.en: I mimic its friend's call. It hesitates.

lines.zh: 它的后颈露着，我等它低头。
lines.en: Its nape is bare. I wait for it to bow.

lines.zh: 我啄了它的手背，皮破了。
lines.en: I peck its hand; the skin splits.

lines.zh: 爪子抓进袖子，撕开一道。
lines.en: My claws dig in and tear the sleeve open.

lines.zh: 我在它脸前扑翅膀，遮住视线。
lines.en: I beat my wings at its face to blind it.

lines.zh: 这一啄偏了，我再来一次。
lines.en: That peck missed; I'll try again.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的尾羽，我转身啄。
lines.en: It grabs my tail feathers; I twist and peck.

lines.zh: 别小看这张喙。
lines.en: Don't underestimate this beak.

lines.zh: 我落在它后颈上，狠狠一下。
lines.en: I land on its nape and strike hard.

lines.zh: 血沾到羽毛上，很难洗。
lines.en: Blood on feathers is hard to wash out.

lines.zh: 我边叫边打，声音比力气管用。
lines.en: I fight while screeching; noise works better than strength.

lines.zh: 它拍我，我掉下去又飞起。
lines.en: It swats me down; I rise again.

lines.zh: 我叼着它的耳垂不松口。
lines.en: I clamp its earlobe and won't let go.

lines.zh: 扑完这一下，我翅膀发软。
lines.en: After that lunge, my wings go weak.

lines.zh: 它倒下了，我落在它胸口。
lines.en: It fell; I land on its chest.

lines.zh: 别夸我，我喘不上气了。
lines.en: Don't praise me; I can't catch my breath.

lines.zh: 这一啄落在它眼皮上。
lines.en: The peck lands on its eyelid.

lines.zh: 爪子挂住它的袖子，我往下坠。
lines.en: My claws catch the sleeve and I hang, pulling down.

lines.zh: 项圈碰到锚，我从土里醒来。
lines.en: The collar touched the anchor; I woke in the soil.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，哑得像旧门轴。
lines.en: My first cry sounds like a rusty hinge.

lines.zh: 丛林的味道不见了，只剩土。
lines.en: The jungle smell is gone; only soil remains.

lines.zh: 我试着扇翅膀，只扬起灰。
lines.en: I try to flap and only raise dust.

lines.zh: 我还记得怎么站在你肩上。
lines.en: I still remember how to perch on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别哭，我回来了，只是不太一样。
lines.en: Don't cry; I'm back, just not quite the same.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛颜色暗了一层。
lines.en: My feathers are a shade darker now.

lines.zh: 重生锚的光让我想起太阳。
lines.en: The anchor's glow reminds me of the sun.

lines.zh: 我抖开翅膀，先学你的声音。
lines.en: I shake out my wings and try your voice first.

lines.zh: 虚弱药水先收起来，好吗？
lines.en: Put the weakness potion away for now, please.

lines.zh: 我又能叫了，虽然很难听。
lines.en: I can call again, though it sounds awful.

lines.zh: 从土里出来时，我在找你。
lines.en: Coming out of the soil, I was looking for you.

lines.zh: 这一身不是原来的羽毛。
lines.en: These aren't the feathers I used to have.

lines.zh: 我站在你手上，爪子有点凉。
lines.en: I stand on your hand; my claws are cold.

lines.zh: 火燎到羽毛，味道很难闻。
lines.en: The flame catches my feathers; the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我从架子上摔下来，摔闷了。
lines.en: I fell off the perch and landed hard.

lines.zh: 水进羽毛，我沉得很快。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers; I sink fast.

lines.zh: 爆风卷起羽毛，我撞上梁。
lines.en: The blast lifted my feathers; I hit a beam.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膀，我飞不稳了。
lines.en: An arrow passed through my wing; I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 法术让我羽毛根根竖起。
lines.en: The spell makes every feather stand up.

lines.zh: 我早就不用吃东西了。
lines.en: I haven't needed food for a long time.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的羽毛焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; my feathers are singed.

lines.zh: 掉下去的地方，连回声都没有。
lines.en: Where I fell, there isn't even an echo.
